db:info.db:title: DualStore Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <typename Lhs, typename Rhs> class DualStore
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test case for documenting non-template hidden friends in class templates

db:abstract.db:para: A two-type-parameter template class with an asymmetric hidden friend.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: The Lhs and Rhs parameters specify the key and value types.

db:section.db:title: [noexcept] void dualCheck(DualStore<Lhs, Rhs> &a, Lhs key)
db:section.db:para: Checks a using key. Dual parameter marker. The documentation renames the template parameters and repeats the correct argument bindings.
